_comment: Role -> model binding. The single reason this file exists: in the pipeline
this was forked from, every step ran on Pi's default model, so the auditing
steps and the authoring steps were the same weights. Fresh context is not
independence. Spec §01 requires the judge to be a different model family so
its blind spots do not match the developer's.
provider is allow-listed to 'ollama' (spec §08). Startup refuses anything
else — that absence is the 'no frontier model at runtime' guarantee, and it

developer.note: Q8_0 + MTP. Q4_K_M (qwen3.8:27b) is the comparison arm — quantization damage on a 27B lands hardest on instruction-following under long context, which is what containment and section-lint depend on. num_ctx here is PI's window — what the agent may fill before it must compact — not the server's. The contained worker honours it because the controller writes the models.json pi reads; the loaded model's own context comes from OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH and is a property of the running server, which pi cannot set. Expect /api/ps to report a different and usually larger number, and do not read that as drift. Raised from 32768 to 65536 on 2026-09-15: the old figure was inherited from the co-residency probe, where it was the most that fit beside the judge, and the regime is serial. Measured consequence of the old number, once the contained worker started honouring it — a single spec session COMPACTED TWICE, which means it lost the earlier part of its own reasoning mid-task. Raise again if sessions still compact.

judge.note: Different family from the developer by design. thinking was `high` until 2026-09-14, when it was measured to produce NO OUTPUT AT ALL: thinking tokens and content tokens share num_predict, and at high this model spends the entire budget reasoning and emits empty content (130 s, cap hit, nothing returned). low and medium both return a judgement in ~100 s. This is not the reasoning level being lowered to flatter a latency number — high does not work here. Revisit if the judge's catch rate on bench/judge-fitness.sh is poor at medium.

smoke.note: Cheap stand-in for the judge while iterating on skill text, where loop speed matters more than verdict quality. Never used for a run whose telemetry is kept.

_known_gaps: pr is bound to developer because the forked pipeline-pr skill still composes the PR body itself. Spec §06 stage 11 makes push/PR pure controller work with no model at all — the pre-PR audit already drafts the body. Fix when the controller lands.

num_ctx is an intent, not a lever: pi exposes no context flag, so Ollama serves what OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH or the last request set. run-step.sh no longer stamps this number as fact -- conditions.num_ctx is read from /api/ps and this value is recorded under conditions.declared with a declared_matches_observed flag. Control still has to come from the unit (a single global value, so it cannot express a per-role context): spec §09 healthcheck.
